name: [UPD] JAWS BELOW
desc:
Update: The Depths 

Fall in, and the sharks find you.

JAWS BELOW is a Poolrooms survival lobby. Cross flooded chambers on tightropes, trapezes, crumbling bridges, swinging tiles and monkey bars while sharks circle in the water below.

MORE ROOMS ARE COMING SOON

llm.loop: cross flooded chambers on tightropes, trapezes, bridges and monkey bars -> avoid falling into shark-filled water -> reach the next room
llm.objectives: survive crossing each flooded room without being eaten by sharks
llm.progression: rooms reached, survivor coins; otherwise unclear
llm.instructions: cross flooded chambers on tightropes, trapezes, crumbling bridges, swinging tiles and monkey bars while sharks circle below
unique: Poolrooms liminal setting with shark hazards under the obby
llm.thumbnails: avatar hanging from a rope over tiled pool water as a great white shark leaps up; first-person view of the rope over a shark
llm.complexity_notes: a few themed rooms with traversal obstacles and shark NPCs
